notes: The waw before lin is unrepresented and the English infinitive marker 'to' stays with the verb it introduces (rules 14, 52); 'to' is not a connective the waw could be rendered by.
'tarry all night' is one unit on lin with the head named as a genuine tie in the unit note, consistent with the same idiom at JDG.19.9.
shene (s005) keeps only 'both' while the suffix takes the whole 'of them' as rectum (rule 19).
